text:
olivia_sre: incident-bot alert: GPU pool gpu-prod-eu-1 is at 98% queue length, autoscaler reported 0 new node launches in the last 10m. paging @mike_oncall :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Pager duty triggered for gpu-provisioning-panic (sev2)
mike_oncall: ack — jumping in, taking primary
olivia_sre: queue growth started ~12:03 UTC, token backlog -> requests pending >500, lat p95 inference >1.2s
jun_solutions: customers hitting errors intermittently? any 5xxs?
olivia_sre: yes, some 429s from fronting proxy due to token throttle, and k8s pods in Pending state for 15+ min
tara_prod: seeing alerts from two customers (finware, chatly) complaining of slow responses / timeouts
infra-bot: Cluster autoscaler event: Failed to scale up: instance group 'gpu-ng-02' attach role mismatch: attachRole not found in launchTemplate
mike_oncall: can someone query ASG/launchtemplate quickly? `aws autoscaling describe-auto-scaling-groups --auto-scaling-group-names gpu-ng-02`
olivia_sre: on it, pasting snippet
olivia_sre: ```
AutoScalingGroupName: gpu-ng-02
LaunchTemplateId: lt-0a1b2c3d4e
MixedInstancesPolicy: LaunchTemplateOverrides: [{InstanceType: p3.8xlarge}]
Tags: [{Key: k8s.io/cluster-autoscaler/enabled, Value: true}]
``` 
olivia_sre: launch template missing InstanceProfile/AttachRole, CA cannot assume the instance profile -> attach fails
mike_oncall: that explains the 'attach role mismatch' error. CA tried to create, instances failed init and got tainted. Pods stuck
jun_solutions: any immediate customer mitigation? can we drain less important jobs and prioritize PLG traffic?
tara_prod: we should offload batch jobs to fallback cluster if possible, start communication to customers
mike_oncall: short-term mitigation plan: 1) scale down non-critical GPU workloads using label selector `batch=true` 2) manually create node with correct instance profile as emergency node 3) fix launch template
olivia_sre: step 1 done — scaled down batch= true by 60% (kubectl scale ...) ; freed ~8 GPUs
infra-bot: manual instance launch attempt failed: instance launched but kubelet failed to register due to bootstrapping taint `node.kubernetes.io/uninitialized:NoSchedule`
mike_oncall: why uninitialized? cloud-init script failing? show cloud-init logs /var/log/cloud-init.log
olivia_sre: found error: `Failed to attach iam role: AccessDenied: iam:PassRole` in cloud-init
mike_oncall: so the instance profile exists but autoscaling/instance-role lacks passrole permissions for the autoscaler service role
jun_solutions: this is different from previous attachRole missing — combination of misconfigured LT and SR role
tara_prod: customer impact note: two enterprise eval accounts were rate-limited; adding to incident report
mike_oncall: I'm going to temporarily increase capacity by requesting a hotfix: create an emergency launch template override with correct InstanceProfile and AttachRole, then force CA to use it by updating ASG
olivia_sre: prepping terraform patch now, will apply with bypass approval
jun_solutions: keep me posted — I'll message CS to give customers ETA
olivia_sre: applied altered launch template (lt-0f9e8d7c6b) referencing instance profile `ri-gpu-node-profile` and updated ASG
infra-bot: ASG update accepted
mike_oncall: trigger CA scale-up: annotate deployment `cluster-autoscaler.kubernetes.io/scale-to`=3
olivia_sre: CA logs now: `Launching instance i-0abc... using launchTemplate lt-0f9e8d7c6b` -> instance initializing
olivia_sre: kubelet registered, node labels applied, taints cleaned
mike_oncall: pods are scheduling onto new node, queue length dropping: pending -> 30
tara_prod: customer CS updated: sent proactive email to finware + chatly; they acknowledged and running smoke tests
jun_solutions: add to post-incident: need stricter CI check for launch template drift and a validation that AttachRole & PassRole permissions exist
olivia_sre: next steps: 1) revert emergency ASG change to avoid drift 2) add automated CA preflight check (launchTemplate has required instanceProfile & iam:PassRole) 3) run canary of new launch template in staging
mike_oncall: I'm going to escalate for a permanent fix — PR for infra policy + terraform guardrails. tagging eng-platform
incident-bot: Sev2 -> mitigated. Postmortem required, please file within 48h
mike_oncall: handing off to on-call followup @olivia_sre; I'll stay available for advisory
olivia_sre: ack, will own postmortem and customer impact summary
jun_solutions: quick customer impact summary: finware saw 18% request loss and 2.3x latency spike for 9m; chatly saw errors for ~7m. both on hosted API, no data loss reported
tara_prod: internal RCA hypothesis: launch template drift + missing iam:PassRole permission introduced during last infra rollout -> CA failed to attach new nodes -> instance init failed -> tainted nodes prevented scheduling -> queue growth -> customer-facing throttles
mike_oncall: will mark incident status: mitigated -> monitoring
olivia_sre: adding runbook action item: add `preflight.sh` for ASG/LaunchTemplate checks and add to release gating
jun_solutions: thanks all, I'll draft the customer comms now
olivia_sre: closing thread here, copying key logs into postmortem
deploy-bot: deploy complete: terraform apply (patch/infra/lt-fix) — ok
olivia_sre: last check: p95 latency back to normal, queue <20; closing at 3851234605 UTC
